description: AdaptWest Climate Adaptation Planning Database is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Data Basin; University of Washington | Landscape Ecology and Conservation Lab; University of Alberta | Applied Conservation Ecology Lab. This spatial database can help land management agencies and other organizations implement strategies that promote resilience, protect biodiversity, and enhance the adaptation potential of natural systems in the face of a changing climate. The database combines broad geographic coverage (most of North America) with relatively high spatial resolution (100 m to 1 km). Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
